---
title: "A block that turns the chrome off"
filters:
  - code-window
---

Each block below turns the chrome off for itself and writes one of the other
attributes the extension reads. None of them belongs in the rendered document.
One attribute per block keeps every fence short enough to read.

```{.python code-window-enabled="false" code-window-style="windows"}
x = 1
```

```{.python code-window-enabled="false" code-window-collapse="open"}
x = 2
```

```{.python code-window-enabled="false" code-window-lines="1,2"}
x = 3
```

```{.python code-window-enabled="false" code-window-no-auto-filename="true"}
x = 4
```
